artifacts.subject: Evidence-led hypothesis testing
artifacts.statement: Choose the smallest discriminating observation that can support or weaken a stated hypothesis.
applicable_situations: Several explanations fit the current evidence
artifacts.action_intent: Gather the lowest-cost evidence that distinguishes the leading explanations.
expected_evidence: An observation that supports or weakens the hypothesis
artifacts.evidence_interpretation: A failed observation can weaken a branch without proving that the underlying service is absent.
success_implications: Promote the explanation supported by the new evidence
failure_implications: Revisit assumptions that could explain the negative result
stop_implications: Stop repeating an action when it adds no evidence
warnings: Do not treat one source as authoritative
